factor_rounding.question: Gate G1 needs your choice on how the Today card's factor values are rounded. Your mock-ups show whole numbers ("14°C", "0 mm/h", "9 mph"), but the planner chose 1 decimal place ("15.0°C", "26.3 mph") on its own. Which should the app show?

negative_rounding.question: One small follow-up on whole-number rounding: how should negative temperatures that end in .5 round? The planner proposes rounding away from zero, so -2.5°C shows "-3°C", and a value that rounds to zero shows "0°C" with no minus sign.

back_button.question: Back button: on the Walks or Dog tab, should pressing the phone's Back button go to Today, and on Today leave the app? This is the usual Android bottom-navigation behaviour.

hour_labels.question: Hour labels on the 12-hour forecast strip: your mock-ups show 2-digit 24-hour labels ("09", "14"). Should they stay 24-hour even when the phone is set to 12-hour time?

long_names.question: A long dog name in the bottom navigation bar (the Dog tab label): may it wrap to two lines or be shortened with "…" on screen, as long as TalkBack always reads the full name?

hour_label_12h.question: Last one before G1: when the phone uses 12-hour time, how should the forecast strip's hour labels look? The planner proposes "2 pm", "12 am" (lowercase, space, no :00), matching the app's best-time text "3:00 pm".

test_changes_E1_E8.question: The design needs eight test changes that weren't on the spec's list of test changes (E1–E8). Most follow controls that moved: Home is replaced by the bottom bar, there's no Back button on the main tabs, and Delete is now inside a "More" menu. One follows wording you approved (D10). Only E1 changes what TalkBack reads: the hero card announcement adds the four factor values, as the spec's AC19 requires. Each new check is exact and at least as strict as the old one. Approve these test changes?

row_delete.question: The spec says the walk row's "More" menu "stays", but in the MVP each row actually has a Delete button directly on it. Criterion AC44 and the mock-ups need a "More" menu. Should Delete move into a "More" menu on each row?

history_back_test_move.question: The Walks tab will have no Back button, so the Walks-screen test "Back returns to the previous screen" can't stay as it is. Its check moves into the main navigation test, where the phone's Back button on Walks must return to Today (Today highlighted, app not closed). The new check is stricter, but the old test is removed from the Walks test file. Do you approve moving it?
